item.title: ESC Joint Guidelines Address Cardiorenal Care
item.description: New ESC/ERA guidelines recommend mandatory dual-parameter screenings and aggressive blood pressure targets, marking a major shift in cardiorenal care.

item.title: New Guidance Adds Diabetes Distress Assessment to Glucose Care
item.description: The European Association for the Study of Diabetes has published its first evidence-based clinical practice guideline, focusing on assessment.

item.title: After 50 Years of Failed Attempts, Is a Drug Vaccine Close?
item.description: Researchers are developing vaccines and monoclonal antibodies to prevent fentanyl overdose after decades of failed attempts to create a drug vaccine.
